REPORT
Date February 6 1940.
Subject Reported change of attitude of Tu Yueh Sung.
Made by. and Forwarded by. Supt. Tan Shao Liang

So far as my enquiries go, there is
no indication that Tu Yuen Sung, a prominent leader
of the Frenchtown fraternity, has changed or is
going to change his pro-Chungking attitude and
return to Shanghai. His sworn brothers, Hwang
Ching Yung, Chang Siao Linz and Yue Yih Feng
(俞葉封)(recently murdered), however, are reported
to have shown sympathy to the Reformed Government.

Tu has a large following in Shanghai.
These have split into two parties, pro-Chungking and
pro-Japanese. Most of the former have left for
Hongkong or Chungking including Chu Hsueh Van(朱學範),
labour leader and Loh Ching Sz(陸京士), whilst
Hsu Yeh Fu(許也夫) was murdered. Noted amongst
the pro-Japanese clique are C.C.Keng(耿嘉基),
Zia Pau Sung(謝葆生), Van Yung Chun (范永增)
(Land Office, City Government). Kau Shing Pau(高鑫寶),
Manager of Lido Cabaret, is another follower of Tu's
who is said to have changed his attitude since his
arrest and release by the Japanese, but this is not
regarded as important.

Comm:
Sir:
J.
R.W. Yorke
D.C. (Sp. Br.)

日期：1940年2月6日。
主题：据报杜月笙态度转变。
呈报人及转呈人：谭绍良警司

据我调查，法租界青帮著名头目杜月笙（Tu Yuen Sung）并无迹象表明其已改变或即将改变其亲重庆立场并返回上海。然而，据报道，他的结拜兄弟黄锦镛、张啸林以及俞叶封（Yue Yih Feng）（近期被谋杀）已表现出对维新政府的同情。

杜在上海拥有大量追随者。这些人已分裂为两派，即亲重庆派和亲日派。前者大多已前往香港或重庆，其中包括劳工领袖朱学范（Chu Hsueh Van）和陆京士（Loh Ching Sz），而许也夫（Hsu Yeh Fu）则遭谋杀。亲日派系中的知名人物包括耿嘉基（C.C.Keng）、谢葆生（Zia Pau Sung）、范永增（Van Yung Chun）（市政府地政局）。丽都舞厅经理高鑫宝（Kau Shing Pau）是杜的另一名追随者，据说他在被日本人逮捕并释放后改变了态度，但这被认为并不重要。

February 4 1940
Mainichi Translation

MAINICHI

GREEN PANG MOVES TO DESTROY ANTI-JAPANESE
TERRORISTS

It is reported that over ten
important members of the Green Pang, which is under
the control of Tu Yuet Sen, have secretly arrived
in Shanghai with a view to re-organizing the Pang
and destroying the social system formed by the
National Government. They have already commenced
their activities towards this end and are advocating
a peace national salvation movement. It is also
reported that they have requested Tu Yuet Sen to
return to Shanghai. They will commence the
following activities:- (1) Prevention of anti-Japanese
terrorist activities, (2) Relief of refugees,
(3) Removal from the Foreign Settlements of Chungking
Government adherents and other undesirable persons
engaged in anti-Japanese and anti-British activities.

（印：FEB 1940 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

《每日新闻》

青帮采取行动摧毁抗日恐怖分子

据报道，在杜月笙控制下的青帮十余名重要成员已秘密抵达上海，旨在重组帮派并摧毁国民政府建立的社会体系。他们已开始为此目的开展活动，并倡导和平救国运动。另有报道称，他们已请求杜月笙返回上海。他们将开始进行以下活动：(1) 防止抗日恐怖活动，(2) 救济难民，(3) 将重庆政府支持者及其他从事反日和反英活动的不良分子从外国租界清除出去。

courtesy name Tu Yueh-sung (杜月笙), was born in 1887 at
Kiaochae, Pootung. The son of a very poor family, he
received little or no education and began his career at the age
of 16 by working as an apprentice in the Dah Yeu (大有)
Fruit Hong, Tih Mao Iang, Li Mah Leo, Nantae. During his
apprenticeship he associated with loafers and frequently
gambled, but due to the influence he had acquired in the
loafer class he managed to escape dismissal. Three years
later, his apprenticeship over, he was promoted shop-assistant
and remained in this position for two years, when, having
misappropriated his employers' money, he was dismissed.
After leaving the Dah Yeu Fruit Hong at the age of
23, he led the life of a loafer in Nantae and subsisted on
proceeds derived from opium-dealing, robbery and extortion.
At that time he was known as "S Kee Yueh-sung (水果月笙)
(Fruit Yueh-sung), and his associates were "Seong Kiang Lau
Doo" (松江老大), "Jang Dau ("robber") Feh Zien" (強盜福泉),
"Van Deong ("rice-bucket") Ah San" (飯桶阿三), "Veong Pau
Zung" (馮寶成) and other notorious loafers in the
district. Through the introduction of the first named,
Tu became the follower of Zung Su-chong (陳世昌) alias
Ah Kou Feh Sung (阿狗福生) alias Tau Tsien Ts Feh Sung
(套籤子福生) who belonged to the "Teeng" (通) class of
the Green Paung. Tu lived in the Tien Sung Lodging
House, owned by Mr. Tsui Sian-keu (朱小狗), at Sing Ka
(新街), Nantae Bund. He was always in a penurious
state and spent most of his ill-gotten gains in gambling.
Four years later his fortunes began to improve.
On the advice of a fortune teller named Pan (潘),
Tu removed to the home of "Van Deong Ah San," at No.12 Sing
pages.zh:
关于杜月笙先生（又名杜玉恩）的备忘录

杜玉恩（Du Yuin）（杜），通常以其字杜月笙为人所知，于1887年出生在浦东高桥（Kiaochae）。他出身于一个非常贫困的家庭，几乎没有受过教育，16岁时开始在南市蒂茂洋行（Tih Mao Iang）里马路（Li Mah Leo）的大有水果行（Dah Yeu Fruit Hong）当学徒。在学徒期间，他与游手好闲之徒交往并经常赌博，但由于他在这一阶层中获得的势力，他得以避免被解雇。三年后，学徒期满，他被提升为店员，并在此职位上工作了两年，后因挪用雇主资金而被解雇。

23岁离开大有水果行后，他在南市过着游手好闲的生活，靠贩卖鸦片、抢劫和勒索所得为生。当时他被称为“水果月笙”（S Kee Yueh-sung），他的同伙包括“松江老大”（Seong Kiang Lau Doo）、“强盗福泉”（Jang Dau Feh Zien）、“饭桶阿三”（Van Deong Ah San）、“冯宝成”（Veong Pau Zung）以及该地区其他臭名昭著的无赖。通过第一人的介绍，杜成为了通字辈青帮成员陈世昌（Zung Su-chong），又名阿狗福生（Ah Kou Feh Sung），又名套签子福生（Tau Tsien Ts Feh Sung）的追随者。杜住在南市外滩新街（Sing Ka）由朱小狗（Tsui Sian-keu）先生拥有的天盛旅馆。他总是处于贫困状态，并将大部分不义之财用于赌博。四年后，他的运势开始好转。在一位姓潘的算命先生的建议下，杜搬到了新

pages.en:
- 2 -

Ka, Nantao Bund. (Ah San is now aged over 60 and is still
living in Nantao). After remaining there for a year,
he, through the introduction of Ah San, became an agent
of Hwang Ching-yung (黃金榮) who was then a detective in
the French Police. His diligence and perspicacity won
the appreciation of Hwang whose paramour, Kwei Sung (桂生),
ex-brothel-keeper from Soochow, often praised him.

When Tu was 30 years of age, through the introduction
of Hwang, he became an assistant in an opium hong in Hongkew
owned by a Cantonese; it was his duty to undertake protection
of opium transportation. As he was capable and on friendly
terms with the loafer class, he enjoyed the confidence of
the manager who soon entrusted him with all the affairs of
the opium hong. About a year later, at 31 years of age,
through the introduction of Hwang Ching-yung, he obtained
employment as manager of a large opium hong on Rue du Consulat
in the French Concession. He was well off financially
and made friends of notorious loafers and junior military
and police officers. At the same time he began to "receive"
followers.

When he was 32 years of age, he established the Mei
Tsung Hwa Kyi (美珍華記) Jewellery Shop, Rue du Consulat,
the manager of which Li Ying-sung (李应生) was one of
his followers. This shop was used for meetings between
Tu and junior officers of the Chinese police and the smuggling
prevention squads. At the age of 35 he became increasingly
rich and notorious. He then had friends in the French
Consulate, the Court, and the French Police.

Apart from smuggling opium, Tu established a concern
known as the "Black Stuff Company" which received fees
ranging from $3,000 to $10,000 per month from every opium hong
in the French Concession, in return for which permission
pages.zh:
- 2 -

街12号“饭桶阿三”的家中，位于南市外滩。（阿三现年六十多岁，仍居住在南市）。在那里住了一年后，通过阿三的介绍，他成为了当时在法国巡捕房担任侦探的黄锦镛（Hwang Ching-yung）的代理人。他的勤奋和洞察力赢得了黄的赏识，黄的情妇桂生（Kwei Sung），一位来自苏州的前妓院老鸨，也经常称赞他。

杜30岁时，通过黄的介绍，成为虹口一家由广东人拥有的鸦片行的助手；他的职责是负责保护鸦片运输。由于他能力强且与无赖阶层关系友好，他赢得了经理的信任，经理很快将鸦片行的所有事务委托给他。大约一年后，31岁时，通过黄锦镛的介绍，他在法租界领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）的一家大型鸦片行获得经理职位。他在经济上变得宽裕，并与臭名昭著的无赖以及低级军警官员结交朋友。同时，他开始“收”徒弟。

32岁时，他在领事馆路开设了美珍华记珠宝店，经理李应生（Li Ying-sung）是他的门徒之一。这家店被用作杜与中国警察及缉私队低级官员会面的场所。35岁时，他变得日益富有和臭名昭著。当时他在法国领事馆、法院和法国巡捕房都有朋友。

除了走私鸦片外，杜还成立了一家名为“黑货公司”的企业，该公司向法租界的每家鸦片行收取每月3,000至10,000美元的费用，作为交换，允许

pages.en:
- 3 -

was granted to sell opium openly and without interference.
The "Black Stuff Company" in turn paid $180,000 per month
to the French authorities. This venture raised Tu's prestige
to a great extent, with the result that loafers in various
districts and detectives of various police stations applied
to be followers of Tu.
Shortly after Tu established an "opium pipe company"
to deal with opium smoking dens in the French Concession.
For each pipe in a den the company collected 30 cents per
day. The collection was made in the afternoon, and after
payment, the officers of the company affixed a seal on the
den's account book. If a den reported the number of pipes
to be less than the actual number, the company would impose
a fine of $50 for each pipe that was not mentioned, and if
a den failed to report its existence to the company but
conducted business secretly, the company would arrange for
the French Police to raid and to deal with the den according
to law. The French Police would not punish the proprietors
of dens whose account books had received the seal of the
"Opium Pipe Company." The Company's income amounted to
about $100,000 per month and all opium smoking dens South
of Avenue Edward VII and West of Mohawk Road paid contributions
and were permitted to conduct business openly. Tu, together
with Hwang Ching-yung and Chang Siao-ling (張林), amassed
considerable wealths and numbered among their associates
and followers, officials, detectives, conductors of gambling
dens, shopkeepers, lawyers, armed robbers and kidnappers.
It was reported that mediation in kidnapping cases proved
very lucrative and Tu in company with his French Town gang
was believed to have received 50% of the ransom paid in all
cases.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

公开出售鸦片而不受干扰。“黑货公司”反过来每月向法国当局支付180,000美元。这项 venture 极大地提高了杜的声望，结果是各地区的无赖和各警察局的侦探都申请成为杜的门徒。
不久之后，杜成立了一家“烟枪公司”，以管理法租界的鸦片烟馆。对于每个烟馆中的每支烟枪，该公司每天收取30美分。收款在下午进行，付款后，公司职员会在烟馆的账簿上加盖印章。如果烟馆报告的烟枪数量少于实际数量，公司将对每支未申报的烟枪处以50美元的罚款；如果烟馆未向公司申报其存在而秘密营业，公司将安排法国巡捕房进行突击检查，并依法处理该烟馆。法国巡捕房不会惩罚账簿上盖有“烟枪公司”印章的烟馆业主。该公司的月收入约为100,000美元，爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）以南、莫霍克路（Mohawk Road）以西的所有鸦片烟馆均缴纳贡金并被允许公开营业。杜与黄锦镛和张啸林（Chang Siao-ling）一起积累了巨额财富，他们的associates和门徒中包括官员、侦探、赌场经营者、店主、律师、武装劫匪和绑匪。据报道，调解绑架案件利润丰厚，人们相信杜与其法租界帮派在所有案件中获得了所付赎金的50%。

pages.en:
- 4 -

His relations with the Kuomintang were first
established in about 1924, when important members of the Party,
which was considered to be an secret organ in Shanghai,
requested him to afford protection. Tu agreed to this
request and several members of the Party took up residence
in the French Concession. Consequently, Tu has been
on friendly terms with the veteran members of the Kuomintang,
including Dr. Chu Min-yi, General Yang Hu, Messrs. Chao Li-
ts and Chen Li-fu.

In April, 1927, when the Nationalist Government
began its anti-Communist campaign, Mr. Tu Yueh-sung together
with two other influential paang leaders in the French
Concession offered assistance to the National Government
in purging Shanghai of the communist elements in local labour
organizations. This assistance was accepted, and Tu and
his associates assembled some 2,000 of their adherents
who, following upon heels of the 26th Army, then in Shanghai,
attacked various unions in Chinese controlled territory.
The successful result of the campaign, in which Mr. Tu claimed
a lion's share, strengthened his influence with the Nationalist
Army.

About a year later, he enlisted the assistance of
certain Cantonese and opened four gambling houses in the
French Concession. Each gambling house contributed daily
$2,500 to be paid as bribes to the authorities. The
bribing was carried out in a tactful manner by Tu himself
and consequently the Chinese and senior foreign members
of the staff of the French Police and French Consulate
were anxious to ingratiate themselves with him, with the
result that his influence in the French Concession increased
greatly. At each gambling house, there were protectors
who prevented loafers from other districts from causing
pages.zh:
- 4 -

他与国民党的关系最早建立于1924年左右，当时被视为上海秘密组织的国民党重要成员请求他提供保护。杜同意了这一请求，几名党员随后迁入法租界居住。因此，杜一直与国民党元老保持友好关系，包括褚民谊博士、杨虎将军、赵立之（音译）（Chao Li-ts）和陈立夫先生。

1927年4月，当国民政府开始其反共运动时，杜月笙先生与法租界另外两位有影响力的帮会首领一起，向国民政府提供协助，以清除当地劳工组织中的共产党分子。这一协助被接受，杜及其同伙集结了约2,000名追随者，紧随当时在上海的第26军之后，攻击了中国控制区内的各个工会。这场运动的成功结果——杜声称在其中占据了最大份额——加强了他对国民革命军的影响力。

大约一年后，他 enlist 了一些广东人的帮助，在法租界开设了四家赌场。每家赌场每天贡献2,500美元，作为向当局支付的贿赂。贿赂由杜本人以巧妙的方式进行，因此法国巡捕房和法国领事馆的中国籍及外籍高级职员都急于讨好他，结果是他在法租界的影响力大大增加。每家赌场都有保护者，防止来自其他地区的无赖制造

pages.en:
- 5 -

trouble. These protectors were all under the control of
Mr. Tu Yueh-sung. It was alleged that they were in
possession of pistols, and conducted illegal activities in
the Concession such as extortion, armed robbery, kidnapping,
etc.

1930 and 1931 were the most flourishing years of
Mr. Tu Yueh-sung's reign in the French Concession, he was
frequently requested by rich people in the Concession to settle
disputes arising over the division of inherited property,
divorce, etc. From cases such as these he considerably
enriched himself. During 1932 the French authorities
banned the functioning of gambling and opium houses in their
Concession. The owners of the houses affected deposited
their capital to the amount of $4,000,000, with Mr. Tu and
requested him to negotiate for the cancellation of the order.
Realizing that the order, issued in compliance with the
decision of the French Government, could not be cancelled,
he constructed the Chung Wei Building and opened the Chung
Wei Bank, using the capital of the gambling and opium house
owners. The owners fearing his power, raised no objection.
Their money was later refunded to them in five yearly
installments. Since then he has endeavoured by every means
to make friends with Government officials.

In July of the same year, 1932, a scheme to introduce
the public sale of opium in the province of Kiangsu was
introduced by the Ministry of Finance, and the Kiangsu
Provincial Government was authorised to conduct the public
sale of opium on September 1. Mr. Tu Yueh-sung negotiated
with the Kiangsu Provincial Government and succeeded in
obtaining the opium monopoly in Shanghai. In pursuance of the
scheme, he established the San Shing Company (三鑫公司) in
Nantao, which acted as the main organ for the supply of opium
to retailers. The Company, it was alleged, disbursed
pages.zh:
- 5 -

麻烦。这些保护者均在杜月笙先生的控制之下。据称，他们持有手枪，并在租界内从事敲诈、武装抢劫、绑架等非法活动。

1930年和1931年是杜月笙先生在法租界统治的最繁荣时期，租界内的富人经常请求他解决因遗产分割、离婚等引起的纠纷。通过这些案件，他大大 enrich 了自己。1932年，法国当局禁止在其租界内经营赌场和鸦片馆。受影响的业主将总计4,000,000美元的资本存入杜处，并请求他协商取消该命令。意识到该命令是遵照法国政府的决定发布的，无法取消，他便利用赌场和鸦片馆业主的资本建造了中汇大楼并开设了中汇银行。业主们畏惧他的权势，未提出异议。他们的钱后来分五年退还给他们。此后，他不遗余力地与政府官员结交朋友。

同年（1932年）7月，财政部推出了一项在江苏省实行鸦片公卖的计划，并授权江苏省政府于9月1日实行鸦片公卖。杜月笙与江苏省政府谈判，成功获得了上海的鸦片垄断权。根据该计划，他在南市成立了三鑫公司（San Shing Company），该公司作为向零售商供应鸦片的主要机构。据称，该公司 disbursed

pages.en:
- 6 -

monthly a total of about $200,000 to the local Chinese
authorities and other organs. Realising that armed
protection was necessary for the transportation of opium, he
succeeded in nominating General Yang Hu as commander of the
Shanghai Peace Preservation Corps. A "Special Service
Department" was then formed by the Corps; this department
took over the work of the San Shing Company, which was "wound
up." The Special Service Department was, however, annexed
and incorporated into the Bureau of Public Safety in the
middle of December, 1932, by the order of Mayor Wu Te-chen.

In 1933, a large quantity of morphia was seized
and confiscated by the Chinese authorities at Hankow. As
it was worth quite a large sum, General Chiang decided to
have the morphia refined and sold for medical purposes.
The sum thus raised was intended for the use of the Blue Shirt
Society.

The task of establishing a factory for refining
the morphia was entrusted to Mr. Tu Yueh-sung who was given
six months to complete the task. A factory was then
established in Nantao, and work was carried on under the
protection of the Chinese authorities. Mr. Tu perceiving
the chance of making a huge profit, secretly arranged with
Mr. Chang Hsueh-ming, brother of General Chang Hsueh-liang,
who was then Chief of Police at Tientsin, to transport to
Shanghai a large quantity of morphia, and make use of the
factory in Nantao to refine it instead of the morphia entrusted
to him by General Chiang. It is reported that Mr. Wu Te-chen,
then Mayor of Shanghai, was given $10,000 every month to
connive at this deception. On the expiration of the
six months time limit, he applied to General Chiang for an
extension of the period on the pretext that the product of
the factory lacked demand on the market, and that as a
pages.zh:
- 6 -

每月向当地中国当局及其他机构支付总计约20万美元。他意识到鸦片运输需要武装保护，便成功提名杨虎将军担任上海保安总团指挥官。随后，该总团成立了一个“特别服务处”；该部门接管了已“结业”的三星公司（San Shing Company）的工作。然而，根据市长吴铁城的命令，该特别服务于1932年12月中旬被并入公安局。

1933年，中国当局在汉口查获并没收了大量吗啡。由于这批吗啡价值不菲，蒋介石决定将其提炼并作为医疗用途出售。由此筹集的资金拟供蓝衣社使用。

建立吗啡提炼厂的任务委托给了杜月笙先生，限期六个月完成。随后在南市建立了一家工厂，并在中国当局的保护下进行作业。杜先生察觉到获取巨额利润的机会，便秘密与当时任天津警察局长的张学良将军之弟张学铭先生达成协议，将大量吗啡运往上海，并利用南市的工厂进行提炼，以此替换蒋介石委托给他的那批吗啡。据称，时任上海市长的吴铁城每月收受1万美元，以纵容这一欺诈行为。六个月期限届满时，他以工厂产品缺乏市场需求为由，向蒋介石申请延期，并称因此导致改造工作延误。

pages.en:
- 7 -

consequence the work of refitting had been delayed.
The application was approved but in the middle of
Autumn, General Chiang received information concerning
Mr. Tu's intrigue. He at once arranged for secret
investigations and discovered the truth. A company of
Military Police was despatched from Nanking to Nantao and
raided the Morphia Factory. On learning of the raid, Mr. Tu
Yueh-sung arranged with Wen Chien-kong (温建纲), Chief
Adjutant attached to the Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner's
Headquarters, to issue written instructions, bearing the
chop of General Wu Te-chen, for the withdrawal of the troops.
The raid was however carried out without interference, and
the written instructions were forwarded by the Military
Police to General Chiang Kai-shek at Nanchang. Greatly
enraged, General Chiang instructed General Wu to submit an
explanation. The Mayor excused himself by stating that he
had no knowledge of the Morphia factory and that one of his
chops which was usually kept by the Chief Adjutant for
office use, had been used without his knowledge. Wen Chien-
kong was subsequently escorted to Nanchang and was subsequently
shot. It is not known how Mr. Tu wriggled out of his own
share in the trouble.
During the same year, 1933, Mr. Tu Yueh-sung became
a shareholder of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory, East
Seward Road, when he was presented by the management of the
company with 1,000 shares, to the value of $15,000, as a
reward for his efforts in settling a dispute existing between
the management and their workers.
Following the assassination of Mr. Sz Liang-tsai
(史量才), then General Manager of the "Shun Pao," on
November 13, 1934, near Hangchow, Mr. Tu Yueh-sung was appointed
pages.zh:
- 7 -

该申请获得批准，但在秋季中旬，蒋介石收到了有关杜先生阴谋的情报。他立即安排秘密调查，并查明了真相。一队宪兵从南京派往南市，突袭了吗啡工厂。得知突袭消息后，杜月笙与淞沪警备司令部首席副官温建纲（Wen Chien-kong）商议，发布了盖有吴铁城将军印章的书面指令，要求部队撤离。然而，突袭行动未受干扰得以执行，宪兵将这些书面指令转呈给在南昌的蒋介石将军。蒋介石大怒，指令吴将军作出解释。市长辩解说他对吗啡工厂一事毫不知情，并称其一枚通常由首席副官保管用于办公的印章是在他不知情的情况下被使用的。温建纲随后被押送至南昌，并被枪决。至于杜先生如何摆脱自己在此事中的干系，则不得而知。

同年，即1933年，杜月笙成为东熙华德路南洋兄弟烟草厂的股东，公司管理层为奖励他在解决管理层与工人之间存在的纠纷中所作的努力，赠予他1,000股股票，价值15,000美元。

1934年11月13日，《申报》总经理史量才（Sz Liang-tsai）在杭州附近遇刺身亡后，杜月笙被任命

pages.en:
- 8 -

Chairman of the Board of Directors of the "Shun Pao," "China
Times," "China Evening News" and the "China Press," all of
which were formerly under the control of Mr. Sz. The
chairman of the Shanghai Citizens' Association, hitherto
located at 1138 Bubbling Well Road, and at present in the
Chung Wei Bank Building, 16 Rue de la Porte du Nord, left
vacant by Mr. Sz Liang-sai, was succeeded by Mr. Tu. An
allegation was current at that time that Mr. Tu was the prime
instigator in the assassination, but it could not be
confirmed. The assassination was however planned by the
Blue Shirt Society, on the ground that Sz Liang-sai had
refused the request of the Propaganda Department of the
Central Kuomintang to place a representative of the local
Tangpu as Chief Editor of the Sz You Dai (自由談), an
editorial page of the "Shun Pao."

Mr. Tu Yueh-sung was first elected a member of the
Supervisory Committee of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce
in June, 1934, through the efforts of Mr. Wong Shiao-lai
(王曉), with whom he had become intimate during the
previous two years. During the next election of the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce in June, 1936, he was elected
a member of the Executive Committee and later appointed
member of the Standing Committee. He still holds
these positions.

In 1935, he was requested by Dr. H.H. Kung, Minister
of Finance, to negotiate with the shareholders of the Bank
of China and the Bank of Communications with a view to
placing these banks under the control of the National
Government. As the share holders were all on friendly
terms with Mr. Tu, in whom they had much confidence,
he was successful in his negotiations, and the banks were
put under the control of the Government during October, 1935.

为《申报》、《时事新报》、《大晚报》和《大美晚报》的董事会主席，这些报刊此前均由史量才控制。上海市民协会主席一职，此前位于静安寺路1138号，现位于北苏州路16号中汇银行大楼，该职位因史量才去世而空缺，由杜月笙继任。当时有传言称杜月笙是刺杀案的主要策划者，但未能证实。不过，此次刺杀是由蓝衣社策划的，理由是史量才拒绝了国民党中央宣传部关于指派一名当地党部代表担任《申报》副刊《自由谈》主编的要求。

1934年6月，在与王晓（Wong Shiao-lai，音译）建立亲密关系的两年后，经王晓努力，杜月笙首次当选为中国商会监察委员。在1936年6月的下一次中国商会选举中，他当选为执行委员，随后被任命为常务委员。他目前仍担任这些职务。

1935年，财政部长孔祥熙博士请求他与中国银行和交通银行的股东进行谈判，旨在将这些银行置于国民政府的控制之下。由于股东们都与杜先生关系友好，且对他非常信任，他的谈判取得了成功，这些银行于1935年10月被置于政府控制之下。

Prior to the opening of the Point Island Fish Market
under the Ministry of Industry on May 11, 1936, the authorities
realizing that the owners of the fish hongs at Marche de l'Est
would oppose the decision of the market authorities requiring
them to remove to the Market, requested the assistance of
Mr. Tu Yush-sung, and as remuneration appointed him the
Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Market. In these
cases the Government owed their success greatly to the
assistance of Mr. Tu, and as a result he gained much favour
with the National Government officials.

Mr. Tu Yush-sung is willing to loose his purse strings
in the settlement of labour disputes; for instance, the strike
of the employees of the Shanghai Electric Construction
Company in April, 1937, in which he contributed $6,000 to
the strikers to compensate them for the pay they lost during
the period of the strike.

The following are some important cases of labour
disputes that were settled by him in conjunction with the
authorities:-

Strike of the employees of the Shanghai Power Company
between September and November, 1933.

Strike of the employees of the French Tramway Company,
July, 1932.

Strike of the employees of the Yee Tseeng Factory,
Peotung, between May and July, 1934, over the closing
of the Old Factory.

His desire to settle labour disputes aims at winning the
confidence of the public and especially the Government
authorities.

On April 12, 1937, Mr. Tu Yush-sung was elected a
member of the committee of the Chinese Ratepayers' Association
of the International Settlement for the year 1937-8.

Mr. Tu Yush-sung's influence is further increased
by the following facts:-
pages.zh:
- 9 -

在工业部下属的点岛鱼市场于1936年5月11日开业之前，当局意识到东方市场（Marche de l'Est）的鱼行老板们会反对市场当局要求他们搬迁至新市场的决定，因此请求杜月笙先生协助，并作为报酬任命他为市场董事会主席。在这些案例中，政府的成功很大程度上归功于杜先生的协助，因此他在国民政府官员中赢得了极大的好感。

杜月笙先生在解决劳资纠纷时乐于慷慨解囊；例如，在1937年4月上海电力建设公司雇员罢工期间，他向罢工者提供了6,000美元，以补偿他们在罢工期间损失的工资。

以下是他与当局共同解决的一些重要劳资纠纷案件：

1933年9月至11月，上海电力公司雇员罢工。

1932年7月，法商电车公司雇员罢工。

1934年5月至7月，浦东益成纱厂（Yee Tseeng Factory）因老厂关闭引发的雇员罢工。

他解决劳资纠纷的意图在于赢得公众，尤其是政府当局的信任。

1937年4月12日，杜月笙当选为1937-1938年度公共租界华人纳税会委员会委员。

以下事实进一步增加了杜月笙的影响力：

a) General Yang Hu, Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander,
is a sworn brother of Tu Yueh-sung, Wang Ching-yeong
and Chang Siao-ling.

b) A number of Tu's followers now occupy governmental or
semi-government posts among which the following are
the most prominent:-

1) Loh Ching-dz (陸京士), Committee member of the local
Tangpu and Presiding Judge of the Soong Wu Military
Court. He is also very influential in local labour
circles.

2) Liu Yuin-fang (刘雲舫), a staff member of the 4th
Section of the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau.

3) Mr. Hsu (徐 ), an inspector in the employ of the
Shanghai City Government Police Bureau.

4) An Tai-tung (安泰東), Officer-in-Charge of the
Kiangwan Police Station of the Shanghai City Government
Police Bureau.

5) Yao Kwang-nai (姚光鼐), Officer-in-Charge of the
West Gate Branch of the Shanghai City Government
Police Bureau.

6) Hsu Ya-fu (许也夫), Chief of the 3rd Section of the
Bureau of Social Affairs.

7) Chu Hsueh-fan (朱学範), Chairman of the General
Labour Union, and Chinese labour delegate to the
International Labour Conference for 1936 and 1937.

c) His successful assistance to many persons in official
circles in settling love affairs has also won for him much
favour and influence. Among these officials, Mr. Sun
Fo, President of the Legislative Yuan of the National
Government, may be mentioned.

Mr. Tu at present holds the following positions:-

Member of the Standing Committee of the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce, North Soochow Road.

Chairman of the Shanghai Citizens' Association,
16 Rue de la Porte du Nord.

Chairman of the Footung Fellow Countrymen's Association,
1484 Avenue Edward VII.

President, the Chung Wei Bank, 16 Rue de la Porte du
Nord.

a) 淞沪警备司令杨虎将军是杜月笙、王庆英（Wang Ching-yeong，音译）和张啸林（Chang Siao-ling，音译）的结拜兄弟。

b) 杜的许多追随者现在担任政府或半政府职务，其中最突出的包括：

1) 陆京士（Loh Ching-dz），当地党部委员及宋武军事法庭主审法官。他在当地劳工界也很有影响力。

2) 刘云舫（Liu Yuin-fang），上海市政府警察局第四科职员。

3) 徐先生（Mr. Hsu，名不详），上海市政府警察局督察员。

4) 安泰东（An Tai-tung），上海市政府警察局江湾分局主管。

5) 姚光鼐（Yao Kwang-nai），上海市政府警察局西门分局主管。

6) 许也夫（Hsu Ya-fu），社会局第三科科长。

7) 朱学范（Chu Hsueh-fan），总工会主席，以及1936年和1937年国际劳工大会的中国劳工代表。

c) 他成功协助官场中许多人处理情感纠葛，这也为他赢得了诸多好感和影响力。在这些官员中，可以提及国民政府立法院院长孙科先生。

杜先生目前担任以下职务：

北苏州路中国商会常务委员。

北苏州路16号上海市民协会主席。

爱多亚路1484号浦东同乡会主席。

北苏州路16号中汇银行总裁。
